correctness.rationale: Uniform k-subsets of [N] correspond bijectively to weak gap compositions. Conditional on r selected-site runs, r−1 of k−1 internal gaps are uniformly chosen positive and, after removing their mandatory ones, remaining gaps plus two outer gaps are a uniform weak composition of M=N−k−(r−1) into r+1 bins. Exact first/second joint factorial moments and pair-distance expression for unbiased V yield E[V|R=r]=k(k+1)/12+[(k+1)(N−k+2)(N+k+1)/(12(k−1))](r−1)/(r+1). Adjacent differences positive for k<N. Separately R=k−sum edge-pair inclusion indicators, and V weighted all-pair indicators divided by k(k−1); exact union-size 2/3/4 overlap weights yield Cov(R,V)=(N−k)(N+k+1)/(6N). Boundary k=2 and N≤3 are separately handled; k=N degenerate R=1 covariance0. Independent exact subset enumeration covered 4017 subsets in 150 conditional groups and 55 parameter covariances for N≤11; this is not all-N proof.
